title: Karaoke Studio v2.1.2 (Halloween Edition)
changelog: 🎃 Halloween Spooky Theme: Complete visual overhaul for TV Stage and Mobile Remote apps with spooky obsidian & glowing pumpkin palette
🕷️ 3D Animated Dangling Spider: Dynamic silken thread swing, bobbing abdomen, wiggling spider legs, and glowing crimson eyes
🕸️ Spooky Corner Spiderwebs & Spirit Bats: Corner cobwebs, web crawlers, and drifting bats and ghosts
🔥 Haunted Keypad & Action Buttons: Burning pumpkin flame Play button, toxic witch green Reserve button, and arcane purple 1st Res
🤍 White 'UP TO DATE' Text: Enforced pure white (#ffffff) styling for UP TO DATE status badges in TV Stage settings and remote with glowing Halloween badges
🎃 Spooky Fanfare Cheers: Festive scoring celebration cheering fanfare messages (Spooktacular Singer, Ghostly Phenomenon, Bewitching Performance)
⚡ Lightweight OTA Web Hot-Patch v5: Instant theme update (~1.5 MB) without redownloading the 764 MB full APK
